description: Download a SOLVED cloud job into a new file beside the source model (<model>_solved.db, never overwriting the original) and make it the active model, so the results tools read from it. Pass save_path to choose the destination.

overwrite.description: Allow save_path to replace an existing file.

save_path.description: Absolute .db path for the solved model. Default: a _solved sibling of the model that was submitted.

name: cloud_solve_fetch_result
